Enter each risk on Risk Register with probability and impact from 1 to 5, the cost if it occurs, an owner, a response and the next review date. Score, level, expected cost and the check fill in by themselves.
Record actions on Risk and Issue Actions, indicators on Risk Triggers and each review on Risk Reviews. Risk Heat Map counts the open risks in each cell.
Log every issue on Issue Log with severity, owner and due date. Age, target days, state and the escalation level fill in. Record each escalation on Escalations.
Log every change request on Change Requests, assess it by area on Change Impact and record the board decision on Change Board Decisions.
Write down decisions on Decision Log, assumptions on Assumptions, and what the plan needs from others on Dependencies.
Record every draw on a reserve on Contingency Drawdowns and link it to the risk that occurred.
After each phase and at the end, write lessons on Lessons Learned with an action and an owner.
Read RAID Summary every Monday: open risks, expected cost against the reserve, issues, changes, assumptions and dependencies of every project, with the items needing attention.

Use the 14 calculators for risk score, expected cost, reserve, response value, change impact, approval route, issue escalation, decision deadline, burn-down, schedule buffer, cost of delay and assumption dates.
Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and tap a message link to send one of 30 ready texts with the details already filled in. Read Risk and Change Dashboard and Charts every week.

listing.title: Project Risk, Issue and Change Log Excel Template: RAID Summary, Heat Map, Decision Log, Assumptions, Lessons Learned
listing.headline: Keep the risks, issues, changes and decisions of every project in one workbook
listing.description:
Keep everything that can go wrong on a project, and everything the team agreed to do about it, in one Excel workbook. Risk Register scores each risk from probability and impact, works out the expected cost and checks that every open risk has an owner, an action and a review date. Risk Heat Map counts the open risks in each of the 25 cells by itself, Risk Triggers watch early-warning indicators against their thresholds and Risk Reviews show whether you held your reviews on time.

Issue Log gives every issue a target, an age, a state and the level it should be escalated to, Issue Ageing counts open issues by project and age band and Escalations records what went up, to whom and what came of it. Change Requests, Change Impact and Change Board Decisions follow a change from the request to the decision, with an approval route set by your own cost and day limits.

Decision Log, Assumptions and Dependencies keep the choices, the things the plan relies on and the things you wait for from others, with deadline warnings. Contingency Drawdowns tie each draw on a reserve to the risk that occurred, and RAID Summary shows for every project the open risks, the expected cost against the reserve, issues, changes, assumptions and dependencies. Lessons Learned turns each phase into an action with an owner.

14 calculators cover risk score, expected cost, reserve, the value of a response, change impact on budget and date, approval route, issue escalation, decision deadline, a what-if grid, burn-down, schedule buffer, cost of delay and assumption dates. Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and send 30 ready messages with the details already written in.

This is part five of the Project manager suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data for a firm running twelve projects to explore first. It helps you plan and check your work and does not promise results.

signature.name: Risk register with score and expected cost
signature.why: probability and impact from 1 to 5 give the score, the level and the expected cost; a check shows risks with no owner, no action or an overdue review

signature.name: Risk heat map with live counts
signature.why: the 25 cells of probability times impact count your open risks and their expected cost by themselves, so the steering group sees where the danger sits

signature.name: Contingency reserve against expected cost
signature.why: for every project the reserve left is set against the expected cost of its open risks, with a warning when the reserve is tight or exhausted

signature.name: Early-warning triggers against thresholds
signature.why: each open risk can carry an indicator and a threshold, and the sheet shows when a trigger is close or reached before the risk occurs

signature.name: Issue log with age, target and escalation level
signature.why: severity sets the target days; age, days overdue and the level the issue should be escalated to are worked out for every open issue

signature.name: Issue ageing by project and band
signature.why: open issues are counted by project and age band, with the high and critical ones shown, so old problems cannot hide

signature.name: Escalations with outcome and days open
signature.why: every escalation records the level, the person, the date and the outcome, and shows when an escalation itself has waited too long

signature.name: Change requests with approval route
signature.why: scope, cost and days effects set the approval route under your limits, and a check flags decisions that wait longer than your target

signature.name: Change impact assessment by area
signature.why: each change is assessed by area with a cost and days estimate, and the sheet shows the cost assessed so far and the assessments still open

signature.name: Change board decisions with speed check
signature.why: approved, rejected and deferred decisions are logged with their conditions and the days from the request, with a late-decision flag

signature.name: Decision log with deadline state
signature.why: decisions keep their options, who decided and the decide-by date, and proposed decisions past their date are flagged as overdue

signature.name: Contingency drawdowns tied to the risk
signature.why: each draw on a project reserve points to the risk that occurred, and shows the reserve planned, drawn to date, left and a warning before it runs out

competitors.lacks: lists risks and scores but has no heat map that counts, no reserve check, no triggers and no link to issues, changes or decisions
charges every month and keeps your risks on its server; this file is yours and every score and check formula is open to read
lists issues with a status but does not set target days, work out ageing or escalation levels, or tie issues to risks and actions
records requests but has no impact assessment by area, no approval route by size and no board decision record
decisions and assumptions are buried in text; nothing flags an overdue decision, an unvalidated assumption or a blocked dependency

messages.moment: Risk owner: trigger reached on your risk

messages.moment: Issue owner: your issue is overdue

messages.moment: Issue owner: critical issue, call today

messages.moment: Project manager: new high risk

messages.moment: Project manager: reserve below exposure

messages.moment: Project manager: issue is ageing

messages.moment: Sponsor: risk summary of the project

documents.title: Risk register report of a project
paragraphs: Risk register report of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
Project: {col:raid.project}. Project manager: {col:raid.manager}. Sponsor: {col:raid.sponsor}. Status: {col:raid.pstatus}. Health: {col:raid.health}.
The register holds {col:raid.open_risks} open risks. Of these, {col:raid.high_risks} are high or critical and {col:raid.critical_risks} are critical. The open risk score is {col:raid.risk_score}.
{col:raid.no_owner} open risks have no owner and {col:raid.overdue_review} reviews are overdue.

The expected cost of the open risks is {col:raid.exposure}. The reserve planned is {col:raid.reserve}, of which {col:raid.drawn} is drawn and {col:raid.left} is left. The reserve check shows: {col:raid.reserve_check}.
Focus of the week: {col:raid.focus}.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Heat map summary for the steering group
paragraphs: Heat map summary for the steering group of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
Project: {col:raid.project}. Project manager: {col:raid.manager}.

Of {col:raid.open_risks} open risks, {col:raid.critical_risks} are in the critical zone of the heat map and {col:raid.high_risks} are high or critical. Together the open risks carry a score of {col:raid.risk_score}.
Their expected cost is {col:raid.exposure}. The reserve left is {col:raid.left}, so the exposure above the reserve is {col:raid.short}. The reserve check shows: {col:raid.reserve_check}.
We ask the group to decide how the open exposure is covered and to confirm the owners of the highest risks.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Issue report of a project
paragraphs: Issue report of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
Project: {col:raid.project}. Project manager: {col:raid.manager}. Sponsor: {col:raid.sponsor}.
The log holds {col:raid.open_issues} open issues. {col:raid.critical_issues} are critical and {col:raid.overdue_issues} are overdue. {col:raid.waiting_client} issues wait for the client.
The average age of the open issues is {col:raid.avg_age} days.
Changes waiting for a decision: {col:raid.open_changes}. Change cost approved so far: {col:raid.approved_cost}.
Every issue has an owner, a due date and an action. Issues that stay overdue are escalated to the next level.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Change request for the client
paragraphs: Change request {col:changes.change_id} of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
To: {col:changes.contact}, telephone {col:changes.client_phone}. Project: {col:changes.project}.
Change requested: {col:changes.title}. Requested by {col:changes.requester} on {col:changes.raised}.
Effect on the scope: {col:changes.scope}. Effect on the cost: {col:changes.cost}. Effect on the plan: {col:changes.days} extra days.
The assessed cost so far is {col:changes.assessed}. The decision route is: {col:changes.route}.
Work on the change starts only when both parties have approved it in writing. The cost is added to the project budget and the days are added to the plan.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Change approval notice
paragraphs: Change approval notice {col:board.board_id} of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
To: {col:board.sponsor}, telephone {col:board.sponsor_phone}. Project: {col:board.project}.
The change board met on {col:board.date} and decided on the change {col:board.change}, {col:board.title}: {col:board.decision}.
Conditions: {col:board.conditions}. Decided by: {col:board.approved_by}.
The change adds {col:board.cost} to the budget and {col:board.days} days to the plan. The decision came {col:board.wait} days after the request.
The project plan, the budget and the risk register are updated. The team starts the work when the conditions are met.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Change rejection notice
paragraphs: Change rejection notice {col:board.board_id} of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
To: {col:board.sponsor}, telephone {col:board.sponsor_phone}. Project: {col:board.project}.
The change board met on {col:board.date} and decided on the change {col:board.change}, {col:board.title}: {col:board.decision}.
Reason and next step: {col:board.conditions}. Decided by: {col:board.approved_by}.
The change would have added {col:board.cost} to the budget and {col:board.days} days to the plan. The budget and the plan stay as they are.
The request may be raised again with new facts or a new estimate. It is then assessed in the same way.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Decision record
paragraphs: Decision record {col:decisions.decision_id} of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
Project: {col:decisions.project}. Project manager: {col:decisions.manager}. Sponsor: {col:decisions.sponsor}.
Decision: {col:decisions.decision}. Date: {col:decisions.date}. Status: {col:decisions.status}. Decided by: {col:decisions.decided_by}.
Options considered: {col:decisions.options}.
The decision had to be taken by {col:decisions.needed_by}. The state of the decision is: {col:decisions.state}.
The decision is recorded so that the team and the client can see why the plan is as it is. A later decision that changes it is logged and this one is marked as replaced.

Issues: {col:raid.open_issues} open, {col:raid.critical_issues} critical, {col:raid.overdue_issues} overdue, {col:raid.waiting_client} waiting for the client.
Assumptions: {col:raid.assume_open} to validate and {col:raid.assume_wrong} proven wrong. Dependencies: {col:raid.open_deps} open and {col:raid.blocked_deps} blocked.

documents.title: Lessons learned report

Project: {col:lessons.project}. Project manager: {col:lessons.manager}. Phase: {col:lessons.phase}. Workshop date: {col:lessons.date}.
What happened: {col:lessons.what}.
Lesson: {col:lessons.lesson}.
Action: {col:lessons.action}. Owner: {col:lessons.owner}. Due: {col:lessons.due}. State: {col:lessons.state}.

documents.title: Escalation letter to the sponsor
paragraphs: Escalation letter {col:escalations.esc_id} of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
To: {col:escalations.escalated_to} ({col:escalations.level}). Project: {col:escalations.project}.
We escalate {col:escalations.kind} {col:escalations.item}: {col:escalations.title}. It was escalated on {col:escalations.date} and has been open for {col:escalations.days_open} days.

zh.Open Start and type your company name an: 打开“开始”工作表,在黄色单元格中填写公司名称及您自己的限值:风险评分等级、评审天数、问题目标天数、变更限额,以及总经理和项目管理办公室负责人的电话。
zh.Fill Projects with each project and its: 填写每个项目和其应急储备的项目. 抽取储备,剩余储备和未完成的风险和问题从其他表格填写.
zh.Enter each risk on Risk Register with pr: 输入每个风险在 风险登记 上,概率和影响从 1 到 5,成本如果发生,一个所有者,回应和下一次审查日期.分数,水平,预期成本和检查自行填写.
zh.Record actions on Risk and Issue Actions: 在 风险和发行行为 记录行动,在 风险触发因素 记录指标,在 风险评估 记录每次审查. 风险热地图 计算每个单元格的开放风险.
zh.Log every issue on Issue Log with severi: 记录每一个问题在 发行日志 上,包括严重程度,所有者和到期日期. 填写年龄,目标日期,状态和升级水平. 记录每一次升级在升级中.
zh.Log every change request on Change Reque: 在 变更请求 上记录每一个变更请求,在 变化的影响 上按区域评估,并在 改变董事会决定 上记录董事会的决定.
zh.Write down decisions on Decision Log, as: 写下关于决策日志的决定,关于假设的假设,以及计划需要其他关于依赖性的决定.
zh.Record every draw on a reserve on Contin: 在 应急使用 上记录每次抽签,并将其与发生的风险联系起来.
zh.After each phase and at the end, write l: 每个阶段结束后,在 学到的经验 上写一个动作和一个所有者.
zh.Read RAID Summary every Monday: open ris: 每个星期一阅读 风险,假设,问题和依赖的总结:开放风险,预期成本对储备,问题,变化,假设和每个项目的依赖,需要注意的项目.
zh.Use the 14 calculators for risk score, e: 使用14个计算器来计算风险分数,预期成本,储备,响应价值,变化的影响,审批路线,问题升级,决策截止日期,燃烧,时间表缓冲,延迟成本和假设日期.

ru.Keep the risks, issues, changes and deci: Ведите риски, проблемы, изменения и решения каждого проекта в одной книге
ru.Control project risks, issues, changes,: Управление рисками, проблемами, изменениями, решениями и допущениями
ru.Risk register with score and expected co: Реестр рисков с оценкой и ожидаемой стоимостью
ru.probability and impact from 1 to 5 give: вероятность и влияние от 1 до 5 дают оценку, уровень и ожидаемую стоимость; проверка показывает риски без владельца, без действий или с просроченным обзором
ru.the 25 cells of probability times impact: 25 ячеек матрицы вероятности и влияния сами считают открытые риски и их ожидаемую стоимость, так что руководящая группа видит, где сосредоточена опасность
ru.Contingency reserve against expected cos: Резерв на риски против ожидаемой стоимости
ru.for every project the reserve left is se: для каждого проекта остаток резерва сопоставляется с ожидаемой стоимостью открытых рисков; предупреждение появляется, когда резерв ограничен или исчерпан
ru.each open risk can carry an indicator an: у каждого открытого риска может быть индикатор и порог; лист показывает, когда триггер близок или достигнут до наступления риска
ru.Issue log with age, target and escalatio: Журнал проблем: возраст, срок и уровень эскалации
ru.severity sets the target days; age, days: серьезность задает целевой срок; для каждой открытой проблемы рассчитываются возраст, дни просрочки и уровень, на который ее нужно эскалировать
ru.Issue ageing by project and band: Возраст проблем по проектам и группам
ru.open issues are counted by project and a: открытые проблемы считаются по проектам и возрастным группам, высокие и критические показаны отдельно, чтобы старые проблемы не терялись
ru.Escalations with outcome and days open: Эскалации с результатом и днями открытия
ru.every escalation records the level, the: каждая эскалация фиксирует уровень, ответственного, дату и результат, а также показывает, когда сама эскалация ждала слишком долго
ru.Change requests with approval route: Запросы на изменение с маршрутом согласования
ru.scope, cost and days effects set the app: объем, стоимость и дни задают маршрут согласования в рамках ваших лимитов; проверка отмечает решения, которые ждут дольше целевого срока
ru.each change is assessed by area with a c: каждое изменение оценивается по направлениям по стоимости и дням; лист показывает стоимость уже оцененного и оценки, которые еще открыты
ru.Change board decisions with speed check: Решения совета по изменениям и скорость
ru.approved, rejected and deferred decision: утвержденные, отклоненные и отложенные решения фиксируются с условиями и днями с момента запроса, с отметкой о позднем решении
ru.decisions keep their options, who decide: решения сохраняют варианты, кто принял решение и срок принятия; предложенные решения, пропустившие срок, отмечаются как просроченные
ru.Contingency drawdowns tied to the risk: Списания из резерва, связанные с риском
ru.each draw on a project reserve points to: каждое списание из резерва проекта привязано к наступившему риску и показывает плановый резерв, списанное на сегодня, остаток и предупреждение до исчерпания
ru.Days ahead to warn of a due date: Дни до срока, за которые предупреждать
ru.Risk score from which a risk is Medium: Оценка риска, с которой риск считается средним
ru.Risk score from which a risk is High: Оценка риска, с которой риск считается высоким
ru.Risk score from which a risk is Critical: Оценка риска, с которой риск считается критическим
ru.Days ahead that an issue is due soon: Дни до срока, когда проблема считается близкой к сроку
ru.Days overdue before an item goes up one: Дни просрочки, после которых пункт поднимается на уровень выше
ru.Days allowed to decide a change request: Дни на решение по запросу на изменение
ru.Change cost the project manager can appr: Стоимость изменения, которую может утвердить руководитель проекта
ru.Change cost the sponsor can approve: Стоимость изменения, которую может одобрить спонсор
ru.Extra days the project manager can appro: Дополнительные дни, которые может утвердить руководитель проекта
ru.Share of a limit that raises an early wa: Доля лимита, при которой появляется раннее предупреждение
ru.Target days to close a low issue: Целевые дни на закрытие проблемы с низкой серьезностью
ru.Target days to close a medium issue: Целевые дни на закрытие проблемы со средней серьезностью
ru.Target days to close a high issue: Целевые дни на закрытие проблемы с высокой серьезностью
ru.Target days to close a critical issue: Целевые дни на закрытие проблемы с критической серьезностью
ru.Projects: sponsor, status and contingenc: Проекты: спонсор, статус и резерв на риски
ru.One row per project with its manager, sp: Одна строка на проект с указанием его руководителя, спонсора, даты, бюджета и резерва на непредвиденные случаи; резервы, оставшиеся, открытые риски и открытые эмиссии заполняются из других листов.
ru.Team: who owns the risks, issues and act: Команда: кто отвечает за риски, проблемы и действия
ru.One row per team member with role and ph: Один ряд на каждого члена команды с ролью и телефоном; открытые риски, открытые вопросы и открытые действия, которыми владеет каждый человек, и просроченные действия заполняются с других листов.
ru.Name: Имя
ru.Risk register: score, expected cost and: Реестр рисков: оценка, ожидаемые затраты и статус пересмотра
ru.One row per risk with probability, impac: Один ряд на риск с вероятностью, влиянием от 1 до 5 и стоимостью, если это произойдет; балл, уровень, ожидаемая стоимость, открытые действия, состояние запуска и проверка отсутствующего владельца, действия или обзора.
ru.Risk heat map: open risks by probability: Карта рисков: открытые риски по вероятности и влиянию
ru.One row for each of the 25 cells of prob: Одна строка для каждой из 25 ячеек вероятность умножена на влияние; оценка, уровень, количество открытых рисков и их ожидаемая стоимость в этой ячейке заполняются из Регистр рисков.
ru.Risk and issue actions: who does what by: Действия по рискам и проблемам: кто и к какому сроку
ru.One row per action on a risk or an issue: Одна строка за действие по риску или проблеме; вид, проект, открытый или законченный, состояние просрочки, дни просрочки и телефон владельца заполняют сами.
ru.Risk reviews: planned, held and what the: Обзоры рисков: запланированные, проведенные и их результаты
ru.One row per risk review with the planned: Одна строка на обзор риска с запланированной и фактической датой; дни задержки, было ли оно вовремя, месяц и телефон человека, ведущего его заполнить сами по себе.
ru.Risk triggers: early-warning indicators: Триггеры рисков: индикаторы раннего предупреждения и пороги
ru.One row per early-warning indicator of a: Один ряд на показатель раннего предупреждения открытого риска с его порогом и последним значением; риск, проект, владелец, доля порога и государство заполняются самостоятельно.
ru.Issue log: severity, age, due date and e: Журнал проблем: серьезность, возраст, срок, эскалация
ru.One row per issue with severity, owner a: Одна строка на вопрос с серьезностью, владельцем и датой погашения; открыто или закрыто, возраст, целевые дни, дни просрочки, состояние, уровень эскалации и контактные телефоны заполняют сами по себе.
ru.Escalations: what went up a level and wh: Эскалации: что поднялось на уровень выше и чем закончилось
ru.One row per escalation of a risk or an i: Одна строка на эскалацию риска или проблемы с уровнем, лицом, датой и результатом; вид, проект, название, дни открытия и состояние заполнить сами по себе.
ru.Title: Должность
ru.Change requests: effect on cost and days: Запросы на изменение: влияние на стоимость и сроки, решение
ru.One row per change request with its effe: Одна строка на просьбу об изменении с ее влиянием на сферу, стоимость и дни; дни ожидания, дни для принятия решения, маршрут одобрения, стоимость, оцененная до сих пор, открытые оценки и проверка решения заполняются самостоятельно.
ru.Change impact: effect by area with cost: Влияние изменений по направлениям: стоимость и дни
ru.One row per area assessed for a change r: Одна строка на одну оцененную область для запроса на изменение с эффектом, стоимостью и днями; название изменения, проект, государство и телефон лица, оценивающего, заполняются самостоятельно.
ru.Change board decisions: approved, reject: Решения совета: утверждено, отклонено или отложено
ru.One row per decision of the change board: Одна строка на решение комиссии по изменению с его условиями; название изменения, проект, стоимость и дни, дни с момента запроса, скорость и телефон спонсора заполняются самостоятельно.
ru.Decision log: what was decided, by whom,: Журнал решений: что решено, кем и что ждет решения
ru.One row per decision with the options co: Один ряд на решение с рассмотренными вариантами и кто решил; возраст, дни задержки, состояние для решений, ожидающих их даты, руководитель проекта и телефон спонсора заполняют сами.
ru.Assumptions: what the plan relies on and: Допущения: на чем держится план и подтверждаются ли они
ru.One row per assumption with the owner, t: Одна строка на предположение с владельцем, дата, к которой он должен быть подтвержден и что произойдет, если это неправильно; дни для подтверждения, состояние, контакт клиента и телефон владельца заполнить сами.

ru.Assumptions: {col:raid.assume_open} to v: Предположения: {col:raid.assume_open} для подтверждения и {col:raid.assume_wrong} доказать ошибку. Зависимости: {col:raid.open_deps} открыты и {col:raid.blocked_deps} заблокированы.

ru.Lessons learned report of {set:firm}, da: Отчет о полученных уроках от {set:firm}, дата {today}.
ru.Project: {col:lessons.project}. Project: Проект: {col:lessons.project}. Руководитель проекта: {col:lessons.manager}. Фаза: {col:lessons.phase}. Дата семинара: {col:lessons.date}.
ru.The lesson goes into the templates and t: Урок входит в шаблоны и контрольные списки следующего проекта, чтобы команда не столкнулась с той же проблемой снова.
ru.We escalate {col:escalations.kind} {col:: Мы поднимаем {col:escalations.kind} {col:escalations.item}: {col:escalations.title} Он был поднят на {col:escalations.date} и был открыт в течение {col:escalations.days_open} дней.
ru.We could not close it at the level of th: Мы не смогли закрыть его на уровне команды проекта. Мы просим вашего решения и поддержки, необходимой для его разблокировки.
ru.Please tell the project manager what you: Пожалуйста, сообщите руководителю проекта, что вы решили и к какой дате.
ru.Invite the team, the sponsor and two cli: Пригласите команду, спонсора и двух пользователей от клиента
ru.Send the risk categories and the lessons: Отправьте категории рисков и уроки прошлых проектов
ru.Score each risk for probability and impa: Оцените каждый риск по вероятности и влиянию
ru.Name an owner for every risk above Mediu: Назначьте владельца каждому риску выше среднего
ru.Agree one response and one action for ea: Согласуйте одно реагирование и одно действие на каждый риск
ru.Open the register and sort it by score: Откройте реестр и отсортируйте по баллам
ru.Check the triggers against their thresho: Проверьте триггеры на соответствие их пороговым значениям.
ru.Close the risks that cannot occur any mo: Закройте риски, которые больше не могут возникнуть
ru.Tell the client contact if it concerns t: Сообщите контактному лицу клиента, если это его касается.
ru.Escalate at once if it is critical: Если это критично, немедленно сообщите об этом
ru.Check progress at the next weekly meetin: Проверьте прогресс на следующем еженедельном собрании
ru.Close it with the reason and the date: Закройте его, указав причину и дату.
ru.Write the problem, the effect and what w: Напишите проблему, эффект и что пробовали
ru.Choose the level from the issue ageing r: Выберите уровень из правила устаревания проблемы.
ru.Close the escalation when the issue is s: Закройте эскалацию, когда проблема будет решена
ru.Check that it is not already in the scop: Убедитесь, что его еще нет в области видимости.
ru.Name the people who will assess it: Назовите людей, которые будут это оценивать
ru.Collect the impact on scope, cost, time,: Соберите информацию о влиянии на объем, стоимость, время, качество и риск.
ru.Note the new risks and assumptions: Обратите внимание на новые риски и предположения.
ru.Send the change papers three days before: Отправьте документы об изменениях за три дня до
ru.Hold the meeting and take each change in: Проведите собрание и принимайте каждое изменение по очереди.
ru.Send the decision to the sponsor and the: Отправьте решение спонсору и запрашивающей стороне
ru.Name who decides and the date: Имя того, кто принимает решение, и дата
ru.Collect the facts and the cost of each o: Соберите факты и стоимость каждого варианта.
ru.Write the decision and the reason in the: Запишите решение и причину в журнал
ru.Check with the client contact where need: При необходимости уточните у контактного лица клиента
ru.Mark it validated or proven wrong: Отметьте, что это подтверждено или ошибочно.
ru.Raise a risk if it is proven wrong: Повышайте риск, если окажется, что это неверно
ru.Invite the team and two client users: Пригласите команду и двух пользователей клиента.
ru.Collect what went well and what went wro: Соберите, что пошло хорошо, а что пошло не так
ru.Name an owner and a date for every actio: Назовите владельца и дату каждого действия.
ru.Add the lessons to the templates and che: Добавляйте уроки в шаблоны и контрольные списки
ru.Expected cost and reserve per project: Ожидаемые затраты и резерв по проектам
ru.Issues raised and closed per month: Выявленные и закрытые проблемы по месяцам
ru.Open Start and type your company name an: Откройте лист «Начать» и введите название компании и свои лимиты в желтых ячейках: уровни оценки риска, дни обзора, целевые дни по проблемам, лимиты изменений и телефоны управляющего директора и руководителя офиса проектов.
ru.Fill Projects with each project and its: Заполните проекты с каждым проектом и его резервом на непредвиденные обстоятельства.
ru.Enter each risk on Risk Register with pr: Введите каждый риск на Регистр рисков с вероятностью и воздействием от 1 до 5, стоимость, если это произойдет, владелец, ответ и следующую дату обзора.
ru.Record actions on Risk and Issue Actions: Запись действий на Риск и действия по выпуску, показатели на Причины возникновения риска и каждый обзор на Обзор рисков. Карта риска тепла подсчитывает открытые риски в каждой ячейке.
ru.Log every issue on Issue Log with severi: Зарегистрируйте все проблемы на Журнал выпуска с выраженностью, владельцем и датой погашения. Возраст, целевые дни, состояние и уровень эскалации заполните. Запишите каждую эскалацию на Эскалации.
ru.Log every change request on Change Reque: Зарегистрируйте каждый запрос на изменение на Запросы об изменении, оценить его по области на Влияние изменений и записать решение совета на Изменение решений совета.
ru.Write down decisions on Decision Log, as: Запишите решения о Журнал решений, предположения о предположениях и то, что план требует от других о зависимостях.
ru.Record every draw on a reserve on Contin: Запишите каждый вывод на резерв на Использование средств на случай непредвиденных обстоятельств и свяжите его с риском, который произошел.
ru.After each phase and at the end, write l: После каждой фазы и в конце напишите уроки на Уроки, извлеченные с действием и владельцем.
ru.Read RAID Summary every Monday: open ris: Читайте Резюме рисков, предположений, проблем и зависимостей каждый понедельник: открытые риски, ожидаемые затраты по отношению к резерву, проблемы, изменения, предположения и зависимости каждого проекта, а также пункты, требующие внимания.
ru.Use the 14 calculators for risk score, e: Используйте 14 калькуляторов для оценки риска, ожидаемой стоимости, резерва, стоимости ответа, влияния изменения, маршрута одобрения, эскалации вопроса, срока принятия решения, сжигания, буфера графика, стоимости задержки и даты принятия.
ru.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Напечатайте 10 листов и 10 документов, следуйте 10 контрольным спискам и нажмите на ссылку сообщения, чтобы отправить один из 30 готовых текстов с уже заполненными данными.
ru.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Все выпадающие списки книги. Измените пункт здесь — он обновится на всех листах.
ru.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Данные обновляются по вашим листам. Измените год, чтобы посмотреть прошлые периоды.
ru.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Выберите значение в жёлтой ячейке — остальные заполнятся автоматически. Готово к печати.
ru.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Измените текст здесь; слова в скобках подставляются из каждой строки. Ссылки находятся в таблицах.
ru.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Выберите запись — для каждого этапа появится срок. Создайте копию листа для каждой записи.
ru.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Актуальные диаграммы по данным ваших листов. Выберите значения в жёлтых ячейках — диаграммы и индикаторы обновятся автоматически.

tr.Keep the risks, issues, changes and deci: Projelerin risk, sorun, değişiklik ve kararlarını tek yerde tutun
tr.Control project risks, issues, changes,: Proje risk, sorun, değişiklik, karar ve varsayımlarını kontrol edin
tr.Risk register with score and expected co: Puan ve beklenen maliyetli risk kaydı
tr.probability and impact from 1 to 5 give: 1-5 arasındaki olasılık ve etki; puanı, seviyeyi ve beklenen maliyeti verir. Sahipsiz, eylemsiz veya gecikmiş incelemeli riskleri bir kontrol gösterir.
tr.the 25 cells of probability times impact: Olasılık çarpı etkiyle oluşan 25 hücre, açık riskleri ve beklenen maliyetleri sayar; yönlendirme grubu tehlikenin nerede olduğunu görür.
tr.for every project the reserve left is se: Her proje için kalan rezerv, açık risklerinin beklenen maliyetiyle karşılaştırılır; rezerv daraldığında veya tükendiğinde uyarı verilir.
tr.each open risk can carry an indicator an: Her açık risk bir gösterge ve eşik taşıyabilir; risk gerçekleşmeden önce tetikleyicinin ne zaman yaklaşıp ulaştığını sayfa gösterir.
tr.Issue log with age, target and escalatio: Yaş, hedef ve eskalasyon düzeyli sorun kaydı
tr.severity sets the target days; age, days: Önem derecesi hedef günleri belirler; her açık sorun için yaş, gecikme günleri ve eskalasyon düzeyi hesaplanır.
tr.Issue ageing by project and band: Projeye ve yaş aralığına göre sorun yaşlanması
tr.open issues are counted by project and a: Açık sorunlar proje ve yaş aralığına göre sayılır; yüksek ve kritik olanlar gösterilir, böylece eski sorunlar gizlenemez.
tr.Escalations with outcome and days open: Sonucu ve açık gün sayısıyla eskalasyonlar
tr.every escalation records the level, the: Her eskalasyon düzeyi, kişiyi, tarihi ve sonucu kaydeder; eskalasyonun kendisinin ne zaman çok uzun beklediğini gösterir.
tr.scope, cost and days effects set the app: Kapsam, maliyet ve gün etkileri, sınırlarınız dahilinde onay akışını belirler; kontrol, hedefinizden uzun bekleyen kararları işaretler.
tr.each change is assessed by area with a c: Her değişiklik, maliyet ve gün tahminiyle alan bazında değerlendirilir; sayfa, şimdiye kadar değerlendirilen maliyeti ve hâlâ açık değerlendirmeleri gösterir.
tr.approved, rejected and deferred decision: Onaylanan, reddedilen ve ertelenen kararlar; koşulları ve talep tarihinden itibaren geçen günlerle birlikte, geç karar işaretiyle kaydedilir.
tr.decisions keep their options, who decide: Kararlar seçeneklerini, karar verenini ve karar tarihini tutar; tarihi geçen önerilen kararlar gecikmiş olarak işaretlenir.
tr.each draw on a project reserve points to: Proje rezervindeki her çekim gerçekleşen riske bağlanır; planlanan rezervi, bugüne kadar çekileni, kalanı ve tükenmeden önceki uyarıyı gösterir.
tr.Days between two risk reviews: İki risk incelemesi arasındaki gün sayısı
tr.Days ahead that an issue is due soon: Sorunun vadesinin yaklaştığı sayılan gün sayısı
tr.Days overdue before an item goes up one: Bir kalemin bir üst düzeye çıkması için gecikme günü
tr.Days allowed to decide a change request: Değişiklik talebinde karar için tanınan gün
tr.Target days to close a low issue: Düşük önemli sorunu kapatma hedef günü
tr.Target days to close a medium issue: Orta önemli sorunu kapatma hedef günü
tr.Target days to close a high issue: Yüksek önemli sorunu kapatma hedef günü
tr.Projects: sponsor, status and contingenc: Projeler: sponsor, durum ve yedek ödenek rezervi
tr.One row per project with its manager, sp: Her proje için yöneticisi, sponsor, tarihleri, bütçesini ve acil durum rezervini içeren bir satır; çekilen rezerv, kalan rezerv, açık riskler ve açık emisyonlar diğer sayfalardan doldurulur.
tr.Team: who owns the risks, issues and act: Ekip: riskleri, sorunları ve eylemleri kim sahipleniyor
tr.One row per team member with role and ph: Her bir ekip üyesi için rol ve telefon ile bir sıra; her kişinin sahip olduğu açık riskler, açık sorunlar ve açık eylemler ve diğer sayfalardan dolanan gecikmiş eylemler.
tr.Name: Ad
tr.Risk register: score, expected cost and: Risk kaydı: puan, beklenen maliyet ve inceleme durumu
tr.One row per risk with probability, impac: Her risk için olasılık, 1 ila 5 arasındaki etkisi ve meydana geldiğinde maliyeti ile bir satır; puan, seviye, beklenen maliyet, açık eylemler, tetikleyici durum ve eksik bir sahibi, eylem veya inceleme için bir kontrolü doldurun.
tr.Risk heat map: open risks by probability: Risk ısı haritası: olasılık ve etkiye göre açık riskler
tr.One row for each of the 25 cells of prob: Her 25 hücre için bir satır olasılık çarpı etki; puan, seviye, açık risk sayısı ve bu hücrede beklenen maliyetleri Risk kayıtları 'dan doldurun.
tr.Risk and issue actions: who does what by: Risk ve sorun eylemleri: kim neyi ne zaman yapar
tr.One row per action on a risk or an issue: Bir risk veya sorunla ilgili bir eylem için bir satır; tür, proje, açık veya bitmiş, gecikmiş durum, gecikmiş günler ve sahip telefon kendi kendilerini doldurun.
tr.Risk reviews: planned, held and what the: Risk incelemeleri: planlanan, yapılan ve değişiklikler
tr.One row per risk review with the planned: Planlanan ve gerçek tarih ile risk incelemesi için bir satır; günler geç, zamanında olup olmadığı, ay ve önderliğin telefonu kendiliğinden doldurulur.
tr.Risk triggers: early-warning indicators: Risk tetikleyicileri: erken uyarı göstergeleri ve eşikleri
tr.One row per early-warning indicator of a: Açık bir riskin erken uyarı göstergesi için bir satır ve onun eşiği ve en son değeri; risk, proje, sahibi, eşiğin payı ve bir durum kendiliğinden doldurulur.
tr.Issue log: severity, age, due date and e: Sorun kaydı: önem, yaş, vade ve eskalasyon düzeyi
tr.One row per issue with severity, owner a: Sorum başına bir satır, ciddiyet, sahibi ve teslim tarihi; açık veya kapalı, yaş, hedef günler, gecikme günleri, devlet, tırmanma seviyesi ve iletişim telefonları kendileri tarafından doldurulur.
tr.Escalations: what went up a level and wh: Eskalasyonlar: bir düzey yükselenler ve sonuçları
tr.One row per escalation of a risk or an i: Bir risk ya da bir sorunun düzeyi, kişi, tarih ve sonucu ile bir sıra; tür, proje, başlık, açık günler ve bir durum kendi kendilerini doldurmak.
tr.Title: Unvan
tr.Change requests: effect on cost and days: Değişiklik talepleri: maliyet ve gün etkisi ve karar
tr.One row per change request with its effe: Arama alanı, maliyet ve günler üzerindeki etkisi ile değişim talebi başına bir satır; bekleme günleri, karar verme günleri, onay yolu, şimdiye kadar değerlendirilen maliyetler, açık değerlendirmeler ve bir karar kontrolü kendiliğinden doldurulur.
tr.Change impact: effect by area with cost: Değişiklik etkisi: alana göre maliyet ve gün etkisi
tr.One row per area assessed for a change r: Değişim talebi için değerlendirilen her alan için bir satır, etkisi, maliyeti ve günleri; değişiklik başlığı, projesi, devleti ve değerlendiren kişinin telefonunu kendileri doldurur.
tr.Change board decisions: approved, reject: Değişiklik kurulu kararları: onaylı, reddedilen, ertelenen
tr.One row per decision of the change board: Değişim kurulunun kararına göre bir satır ve koşulları; değişiklik başlığı, projesi, maliyeti ve günleri, talepden sonraki günler, hız ve sponsor telefonu kendi kendilerine doldurulur.
tr.Decision log: what was decided, by whom,: Karar günlüğü: neye karar verildi, kim ve ne bekliyor
tr.One row per decision with the options co: Her karar için bir satır, düşünülen seçenekler ve kimin karar verdiği; yaş, günler geç, kararlar için bekleyen bir durum, proje yöneticisi ve sponsor telefonu kendileri tarafından doldurulur.
tr.Assumptions: what the plan relies on and: Varsayımlar: plan neye dayanıyor ve geçerli mi
tr.One row per assumption with the owner, t: Sahibi ile varsayım başına bir satır, onaylanması gereken tarih ve yanlışsa ne olur; onaylanması gereken günler, bir durum, müşteri bağlantısı ve sahibi telefonu kendi kendilerine doldurulur.
tr.Dependencies: what the plan needs from o: Bağımlılıklar: planın başkalarından ihtiyaç duyduğu şeyler
tr.One row per dependency or constraint wit: Bağımlılık veya kısıtlama başına bir satır, kimin verdiği ve kimin ihtiyacı olduğu, gerekli tarih ve şirketin dışında olup olmadığı; kalan günler, bir durum ve telefonlar kendi kendilerini dolduruyor.
tr.Lessons learned: what happened and what: Öğrenilen dersler: ne oldu ve neyi değiştiriyoruz
tr.One row per lesson with the phase, what: Ders başına bir satır, aşama, ne oldu, ders ve yapılacak eylem; yıl, eylem için bir durum ve sahip telefon kendi kendilerini doldurun.
tr.Contingency drawdowns: reserve used by r: Yedek ödenek çekimleri: gerçekleşen risklerin rezervi
tr.One row per draw on a project reserve, l: Bir proje rezervi için çekim başına bir satır, ortaya çıkan riskle bağlantılı; proje, planlanan rezerv, çekilen tarih, kalan rezerv, kullanılan hisse ve kendi kendilerine doldurulan bir çek.
tr.RAID summary: one line per project: RAID özeti: proje başına bir satır
tr.One row per project; type the focus of t: Proje başına bir satır; haftanın odak noktasını yazın. Açık riskler, rezerve karşı beklenen maliyetler, sorunlar, değişiklikler, varsayımlar ve bağımlılıklar diğer sayfalardan hesaplanır.
tr.Exposure by level: open risks and cost p: Düzeye göre maruziyet: açık riskler ve proje başına maliyet
tr.One row for each project and risk level;: Her proje ve risk düzeyi için bir satır; açık risklerin sayısı, beklenen maliyeti ve proje maruziyetinin payı Risk kayıtları sayısından doldurulur.
tr.Issue ageing: open issues per project an: Sorun yaşlanması: proje ve yaş aralığı başına açık
tr.One row for each project and age band wi: Her proje ve yaş grubu için, grubun ilk ve son gününü içeren bir satır; grubun açık ve yüksek veya kritik olanlarının sayısı Çıkış günlüğü'dan doldurulur.
tr.Risk cost, change cost and reserve drawn: Aylık risk maliyeti, değişiklik maliyeti ve rezerv çekimi
tr.Risk score and level from probability an: Olasılık ve etkiden risk puanı ve düzeyi
tr.Type the probability and the impact from: Olasılık ve etkisi 1 ila 5 arasında yazın; puanı, seviyesini, sayının arkasındaki şansı, bir sonraki seviyeye işaretleri ve riskin ne sıklıkla gözden geçirilmesi gerektiğini görün.
tr.Expected cost of a risk, with a three-po: Bir riskin beklenen maliyeti, üç nokta aralığıyla

tr.Contingency reserve from the open risks: Bir projenin açık risklerinden yedek ödenek rezervi
tr.Pick a project and a safety margin; open: Bir projeyi ve bir güvenlik marjını seçin; açık riskler, beklenen maliyetleri ve planlanan, çekilen ve bırakılan rezervler sayfalarınızdan gelir; gerekli rezervleri, herhangi bir eksikliği ve kapsamlı payı görün.
tr.Risk exposure before and after the respo: Yanıttan önce ve sonra risk maruziyeti
tr.Type the chance and cost of the risk bef: Cevabınızdan önce ve sonra riskin olasılığı ve maliyeti ve yanıtın maliyeti yazın; önce ve sonra maruziyet, tasarruf, net fayda ve hala ödeme yapan en büyük şansı görün.
tr.Cost if it occurs before: Daha önce meydana gelmesi durumunda maliyet
tr.Reduction as a share of the exposure bef: Daha önce maruz kalma payı olarak azalma
tr.Return for each unit spent on the respon: Yanıta harcanan her birim için getiri

id.Control project risks, issues, changes,: Kendalikan risiko, isu, perubahan, keputusan, dan asumsi proyek
id.Risk register with score and expected co: Daftar risiko dengan skor dan biaya diharapkan
id.probability and impact from 1 to 5 give: kemungkinan dan dampak 1-5 menghasilkan skor, tingkat, dan biaya yang diharapkan; cek menandai risiko tanpa pemilik, tindakan, atau tinjauan lewat tenggat
id.Risk heat map with live counts: Peta panas risiko dengan jumlah langsung
id.the 25 cells of probability times impact: 25 sel kemungkinan kali dampak menghitung risiko terbuka dan biaya diharapkannya, sehingga kelompok pengarah melihat letak bahaya
id.for every project the reserve left is se: untuk setiap proyek, sisa cadangan dibandingkan dengan biaya diharapkan dari risiko terbuka, dengan peringatan ketika cadangan ketat atau habis
id.each open risk can carry an indicator an: setiap risiko terbuka dapat memiliki indikator dan ambang, dan lembar menunjukkan kapan pemicu mendekati atau tercapai sebelum risiko terjadi
id.Issue log with age, target and escalatio: Log isu: usia, target, dan tingkat eskalasi
id.severity sets the target days; age, days: tingkat keparahan menetapkan hari target; usia, hari lewat tenggat, dan tingkat eskalasi yang tepat dihitung untuk setiap isu terbuka
id.Issue ageing by project and band: Usia isu per proyek dan rentang usia
id.open issues are counted by project and a: isu terbuka dihitung per proyek dan rentang usia, dengan isu tinggi dan kritis ditampilkan, agar isu lama tidak tersembunyi
id.Escalations with outcome and days open: Eskalasi dengan hasil dan hari terbuka
id.every escalation records the level, the: setiap eskalasi mencatat tingkat, orang, tanggal, dan hasilnya, serta menunjukkan jika eskalasi itu sendiri menunggu terlalu lama
id.scope, cost and days effects set the app: dampak ruang lingkup, biaya, dan hari menentukan alur persetujuan sesuai batas Anda; cek menandai keputusan yang menunggu lebih lama dari target
id.each change is assessed by area with a c: setiap perubahan dinilai per area dengan perkiraan biaya dan hari; lembar menunjukkan biaya yang sudah dinilai dan penilaian yang masih terbuka
id.approved, rejected and deferred decision: keputusan disetujui, ditolak, dan ditunda dicatat beserta kondisi dan jumlah hari sejak permintaan, dengan penanda keputusan terlambat
id.decisions keep their options, who decide: keputusan menyimpan opsi, siapa yang memutuskan, dan tanggal putusan; usulan keputusan yang melewati tanggalnya ditandai lewat tenggat
id.each draw on a project reserve points to: setiap penarikan dari cadangan proyek menunjuk risiko yang terjadi, dan menampilkan cadangan rencana, yang sudah ditarik, sisa, serta peringatan sebelum habis
id.Days ahead to warn of a due date: Hari sebelum jatuh tempo untuk peringatan
id.Risk score from which a risk is Medium: Skor risiko mulai dari mana risiko dianggap sedang
id.Risk score from which a risk is High: Skor risiko mulai dari mana risiko dianggap tinggi
id.Risk score from which a risk is Critical: Skor risiko mulai dari mana risiko dianggap kritis
id.Days ahead that an issue is due soon: Hari ke depan saat isu dianggap segera jatuh tempo
id.Days overdue before an item goes up one: Hari terlambat sebelum item naik satu tingkat
id.Days allowed to decide a change request: Hari yang diizinkan untuk memutuskan permintaan perubahan
id.Change cost the project manager can appr: Biaya perubahan yang dapat disetujui manajer proyek
id.Change cost the sponsor can approve: Biaya perubahan yang dapat disetujui sponsor
id.Extra days the project manager can appro: Hari tambahan yang dapat disetujui manajer proyek
id.Share of a limit that raises an early wa: Porsi dari batas yang memicu peringatan dini
id.Target days to close a low issue: Target hari untuk menutup isu rendah
id.Target days to close a medium issue: Target hari untuk menutup isu sedang
id.Target days to close a high issue: Target hari untuk menutup isu tinggi
id.Target days to close a critical issue: Target hari untuk menutup isu kritis
id.Projects: sponsor, status and contingenc: Proyek: sponsor, status, dan cadangan kontingensi
id.One row per project with its manager, sp: Satu baris per proyek dengan manajer, sponsor, tanggal, anggaran dan cadangan darurat; cadangan yang diambil, cadangan yang tersisa, risiko terbuka dan emisi terbuka diisi dari lembar lainnya.
id.Team: who owns the risks, issues and act: Tim: siapa memiliki risiko, isu, dan tindakan
id.One row per team member with role and ph: Satu baris per anggota tim dengan peran dan telepon; risiko terbuka, isu terbuka dan tindakan terbuka yang dimiliki setiap orang dan tindakan tertunda mengisi dari lembar lain.
id.Name: Nama
id.Risk register: score, expected cost and: Daftar risiko: skor, biaya diharapkan, dan status tinjauan
id.One row per risk with probability, impac: Satu baris per risiko dengan probabilitas, dampak dari 1 sampai 5 dan biaya jika terjadi; skor, tingkat, biaya yang diharapkan, tindakan terbuka, keadaan pemicu dan pemeriksaan untuk pemilik yang hilang, tindakan atau tinjauan isi.
id.Risk heat map: open risks by probability: Peta panas: risiko terbuka per kemungkinan dan dampak
id.One row for each of the 25 cells of prob: Satu baris untuk masing-masing 25 sel kemungkinan kali dampak; skor, tingkat, jumlah risiko terbuka dan biaya yang diharapkan di sel tersebut diisi dari Daftar risiko.
id.Risk and issue actions: who does what by: Tindakan risiko dan isu: siapa melakukan apa dan kapan
id.One row per action on a risk or an issue: Satu baris per tindakan pada risiko atau masalah; jenis, proyek, terbuka atau selesai, status tertunda, hari tertunda dan pemilik telepon mengisi sendiri.
id.Risk reviews: planned, held and what the: Tinjauan risiko: rencana, dilakukan, dan perubahannya
id.One row per risk review with the planned: Satu baris per tinjauan risiko dengan tanggal yang direncanakan dan yang sebenarnya; hari-hari terlambat, apakah tepat waktu, bulan dan telepon orang yang memimpin itu mengisi sendiri.
id.Risk triggers: early-warning indicators: Pemicu risiko: indikator peringatan dini dan ambang
id.One row per early-warning indicator of a: Satu baris per indikator peringatan dini risiko terbuka dengan ambang dan nilai terbaru; risiko, proyek, pemilik, pangsa ambang dan negara mengisi sendiri.
id.Issue log: severity, age, due date and e: Log isu: tingkat keparahan, usia, jatuh tempo, eskalasi
id.One row per issue with severity, owner a: Satu baris per masalah dengan tingkat keparahan, pemilik dan tanggal jatuh tempo; terbuka atau ditutup, usia, hari target, hari keterlambatan, negara, tingkat eskalasi dan telepon kontak mengisi sendiri.
id.Escalations: what went up a level and wh: Eskalasi: apa yang naik tingkat dan hasilnya
id.One row per escalation of a risk or an i: Satu baris per eskalasi risiko atau masalah dengan tingkat, orang, tanggal dan hasil; jenis, proyek, judul, hari terbuka dan negara mengisi sendiri.
id.Title: Jabatan
id.Change requests: effect on cost and days: Permintaan perubahan: dampak biaya dan hari, serta keputusan
id.One row per change request with its effe: Satu baris per permintaan perubahan dengan dampaknya pada ruang lingkup, biaya dan hari; hari menunggu, hari untuk memutuskan, rute persetujuan, biaya yang dinilai sejauh ini, penilaian terbuka dan pemeriksaan keputusan diisi sendiri.
id.Change impact: effect by area with cost: Dampak perubahan: efek per area dengan biaya dan hari
id.One row per area assessed for a change r: Satu baris per area yang dinilai untuk permintaan perubahan dengan efek, biaya dan hari; judul perubahan, proyek, negara dan telepon orang yang menilai diisi sendiri.
id.Change board decisions: approved, reject: Keputusan dewan perubahan: disetujui, ditolak, atau ditunda
id.One row per decision of the change board: Satu baris per keputusan dewan perubahan dengan kondisinya; judul perubahan, proyek, biaya dan hari, hari dari permintaan, kecepatan dan telepon sponsor mengisi sendiri.
id.Decision log: what was decided, by whom,: Log keputusan: apa yang diputuskan, oleh siapa, dan status
id.One row per decision with the options co: Satu baris per keputusan dengan pilihan yang dipertimbangkan dan yang memutuskan; usia, hari-hari terlambat, keadaan untuk keputusan menunggu tanggal mereka, manajer proyek dan telepon sponsor mengisi sendiri.
id.Assumptions: what the plan relies on and: Asumsi: apa yang diandalkan rencana dan apakah masih berlaku
id.One row per assumption with the owner, t: Satu baris per asumsi dengan pemilik, tanggal yang harus divalidasi dan apa yang terjadi jika salah; hari untuk memvalidasi, sebuah negara, kontak klien dan telepon pemilik mengisi sendiri.
id.Dependencies: what the plan needs from o: Ketergantungan: apa yang dibutuhkan rencana dari pihak lain
id.One row per dependency or constraint wit: Satu baris per ketergantungan atau kendala dengan siapa yang memberikannya dan siapa yang membutuhkannya, tanggal yang dibutuhkan, dan apakah itu di luar perusahaan; hari yang tersisa, sebuah negara dan telepon mengisi sendiri.
id.Lessons learned: what happened and what: Pelajaran yang dipetik: apa yang terjadi dan perubahannya
id.One row per lesson with the phase, what: Satu baris per pelajaran dengan fase, apa yang terjadi, pelajaran dan tindakan yang harus dilakukan; tahun, keadaan untuk tindakan dan pemilik telepon mengisi sendiri.
id.Contingency drawdowns: reserve used by r: Penarikan kontingensi: cadangan untuk risiko yang terjadi
id.One row per draw on a project reserve, l: Satu baris per undian pada cadangan proyek, terkait dengan risiko yang terjadi; proyek, cadangan yang direncanakan, yang ditarik hingga saat ini, cadangan yang tersisa, saham yang digunakan dan cek yang diisi sendiri.
id.RAID summary: one line per project: Ringkasan RAID: satu baris per proyek
id.One row per project; type the focus of t: Satu baris per proyek; ketik fokus minggu. risiko terbuka, biaya yang diharapkan terhadap cadangan, emisi, perubahan, asumsi dan ketergantungan menghitung diri dari lembar lain.
id.Expected cost of open risks: Biaya yang diharapkan dari risiko terbuka
id.Exposure by level: open risks and cost p: Eksposur per tingkat: risiko terbuka dan biaya per proyek
id.One row for each project and risk level;: Satu baris untuk setiap proyek dan tingkat risiko; jumlah risiko terbuka, biaya yang diharapkan dan bagian dari eksposur proyek diisi dari Daftar risiko.
id.Issue ageing: open issues per project an: Usia isu: isu terbuka per proyek dan rentang usia
id.One row for each project and age band wi: Satu baris untuk setiap proyek dan kelompok usia dengan hari pertama dan terakhir band; jumlah masalah terbuka dan yang tinggi atau kritis di band diisi dari Log Penerbitan.
id.Risk cost, change cost and reserve drawn: Biaya risiko, perubahan, dan cadangan ditarik per bulan
id.Change request sheet with the board deci: Lembar permintaan perubahan dengan keputusan dewan
id.Change impact sheet with its assessment: Lembar dampak perubahan dengan baris penilaian
id.Risk score and level from probability an: Skor risiko dan tingkat dari kemungkinan dan dampak
id.Type the probability and the impact from: Ketik kemungkinan dan dampak dari 1 sampai 5; lihat skor, tingkat, peluang di balik angka, poin ke tingkat berikutnya dan seberapa sering risiko harus ditinjau kembali.
id.Expected cost of a risk, with a three-po: Biaya risiko yang diharapkan dengan rentang tiga titik
id.Type the chance and a low, likely and hi: Ketik kemungkinan dan biaya rendah, kemungkinan dan tinggi jika risiko terjadi; lihat biaya yang diharapkan, biaya tiga poin, biaya yang diharapkan dalam kasus terburuk dan jumlah yang harus dipegang untuk risiko.
id.Expected cost at the likely cost: Biaya yang diharapkan pada biaya paling mungkin
id.Expected cost at the low cost: Biaya yang diharapkan pada biaya rendah
id.Expected cost at the high cost: Biaya yang diharapkan pada biaya tinggi
id.Amount to hold in the reserve: Jumlah yang harus disimpan dalam cadangan
id.Contingency reserve from the open risks: Cadangan kontingensi dari risiko terbuka proyek
id.Pick a project and a safety margin; open: Pilih proyek dan margin keamanan; risiko terbuka, biaya yang diharapkan dan cadangan yang direncanakan, ditarik dan ditinggalkan berasal dari lembar Anda; lihat cadangan yang diperlukan, defisit dan bagian yang ditutupi.
id.Safety margin on the expected cost: Margin keamanan terhadap biaya yang diharapkan
id.Expected cost of the open risks: Biaya yang diharapkan dari risiko terbuka
id.Reserve needed with the safety margin: Cadangan yang dibutuhkan dengan margin keamanan
id.Share of the expected cost the reserve c: Bagian biaya yang diharapkan yang ditanggung cadangan
id.Risk exposure before and after the respo: Eksposur risiko sebelum dan sesudah respons
id.Type the chance and cost of the risk bef: Ketik kemungkinan dan biaya risiko sebelum dan setelah respon Anda, dan biaya respons; lihat eksposur sebelum dan setelah, tabungan, keuntungan bersih dan peluang tertinggi yang masih membayar.
id.Reduction as a share of the exposure bef: Pengurangan sebagai persentase dari eksposur sebelum
id.Return for each unit spent on the respon: Pengembalian untuk setiap unit yang dihabiskan untuk respons
id.Highest chance after the response that s: Peluang tertinggi setelah respons yang masih menguntungkan
id.Change impact on budget and end date: Dampak perubahan pada anggaran dan tanggal akhir
id.Type the budget, the reserve left, the p: Ketik anggaran, cadangan yang tersisa, akhir yang direncanakan, biaya dan hari perubahan dan buffer jadwal yang tersisa; lihat anggaran baru, apa yang dapat diserap oleh cadangan dan buffer dan tanggal akhir yang baru.
id.End date with all days added: Tanggal akhir dengan semua hari ditambahkan
id.Working days the buffer cannot absorb: Hari kerja yang tidak bisa diserap buffer
id.Days from today to the new end date: Hari dari hari ini sampai tanggal akhir baru
id.Change takes twice the days: Perubahan memakan waktu dua kali lipat hari
id.Change approval route by size and effect: Alur persetujuan perubahan menurut ukuran dan dampak
id.Type the cost and the extra days of a ch: Ketik biaya dan hari tambahan dari perubahan; lihat siapa yang dapat menyetujuinya di bawah batas Anda, seberapa jauh di atas setiap batas dan berapa hari keputusan yang diizinkan.
id.Cost above the project manager limit: Biaya di atas batas manajer proyek
id.Pick the severity and type how long the: Pilih tingkat keparahan dan ketik berapa lama masalah telah terbuka dan berapa hari yang terlambat; lihat target hari, usia terhadap target dan tingkat masalah harus meningkat ke.
id.Twenty days open and overdue: Dua puluh hari terbuka dan terlambat
id.Latest date to decide so the plan holds: Tanggal terakhir keputusan agar rencana tetap berjalan
id.Type the date the dependent work starts,: Ketik tanggal pekerjaan dependen dimulai, waktu yang dibutuhkan pilihan, hari untuk mempersiapkan opsi dan margin keamanan; lihat tanggal terakhir untuk memutuskan dan tanggal opsi harus siap.
id.Days from today to the decision date: Hari dari hari ini sampai tanggal keputusan
id.Days from today to the options date: Hari dari hari ini sampai tanggal opsi
id.Days the start can slip before the plan: Hari mulai boleh bergeser sebelum rencana gagal
id.Type the probability, the impact and the: Ketik kemungkinan, dampak dan biaya jika risiko terjadi; lihat skor, tingkat dan biaya yang diharapkan.
id.Expected cost per point of score: Biaya yang diharapkan per poin skor
id.Score if the impact falls by one: Skor jika dampak turun dengan satu
id.Expected cost if the probability falls b: Biaya yang diharapkan jika probabilitas turun satu
id.Weekly risk burn-down: open exposure ove: Penurunan risiko mingguan: eksposur terbuka per minggu
id.Type the exposure now, the share you clo: Ketik eksposur sekarang, saham yang Anda tutup setiap minggu, eksposur baru yang ditambahkan setiap minggu dan jumlah minggu; lihat eksposur setelah minggu-minggu itu, tingkat stabil dan apakah Anda mencapai target Anda.
id.Expected cost of open risks now: Biaya yang diharapkan dari risiko terbuka saat ini
id.Share of the exposure closed each week: Persentase eksposur yang ditutup setiap minggu
id.New exposure added each week: Eksposur baru yang ditambahkan setiap minggu
id.Share of today exposure left: Persentase eksposur hari ini yang tersisa
id.Schedule buffer from the days that risks: Buffer jadwal dari hari yang bisa ditambahkan risiko
id.Type up to three schedule risks with the: Masukkan hingga tiga risiko jadwal dengan kesempatan mereka dan hari yang ditambahkan, buffer yang direncanakan dan bagian dari celah untuk kasus terburuk untuk ditanggung; lihat penundaan yang diharapkan dan buffer untuk direncanakan.
id.Share of the gap to the worst case to co: Bagian dari selisih ke kasus terburuk yang perlu ditanggung
id.Worst case if all three occur, days: Kasus terburuk jika ketiganya terjadi, hari
id.Buffer planned less buffer to plan: Buffer yang direncanakan dikurangi buffer yang perlu
id.Buffer as a share of the worst case: Buffer sebagai bagian dari kasus terburuk
id.Type how many people are blocked, the co: Ketik berapa banyak orang yang diblokir, biaya per jam, hari dan bagian dari hari yang hilang, biaya lain per hari dan biaya untuk memperbaikinya; lihat biaya penundaan dan apakah memperbaikinya sekarang membayar.
id.Days of delay at which the fix pays for: Hari penundaan saat perbaikan mulai untung
id.Type the date the dependent work starts,: Ketik tanggal kerja dependen dimulai, hari-hari untuk merencanakan kembali jika asumsi salah, margin keamanan dan hari-hari pemeriksaan; lihat tanggal untuk memvalidasi dan kapan untuk memulai pemeriksaan.
id.Days needed to re-plan if it is wrong: Hari yang dibutuhkan untuk merencanakan kembali jika itu salah
id.Days from today to validate by: Hari dari hari ini sampai batas validasi
id.Days from today to start checking: Hari dari hari ini sampai mulai pemeriksaan
